meaning: reports/release-control.json and reports/release-power.json say release_ready only when Synth's own routing and export gates pass. They are not review sign-off. This file stays false until every gate below is true.

multiboard_mapping.evidence: crates/synth-cli/tests/bldc_stack_board.rs: 20 of 20 J_B2B pins matched, 100%, no diagnostics; every pin of the connector appears exactly once.

negative_mappings.evidence: Swap (mappings_neg_swap.json), drop (mappings_neg_drop.json), 12V/3.3V exchange (mappings_neg_voltage.json) and a source-level pin swap (control_neg_swap.synth) each return status warning with E-SYNTH-MULTIBOARD-003, -004 or -005.

mechanical_alignment.evidence: Sidecar comparison in the same test: J_B2B and H1-H4 are at identical board coordinates on both boards with 0.000 mm X/Y mismatch and equal rotation.

routing_and_drc.evidence: No routed copper exists. `synth export-kicad --router free-routing` fails in tools/freeroute_autoroute.py with a KiCad PROPERTY_ENUM assert before the route stage; the same failure reproduces on the committed Class-B buck board. The un-routed control PCB reports 0 DRC errors, 97 unconnected pads and 112 warnings.

erc_dispositioned.evidence: kicad-cli sch erc reports 0 errors on both schematics: 6 warnings on control (4 isolated_pin_label, 2 no_connect_connected) and 15 on power (14 lib_symbol_mismatch, 1 label_multiple_wires). passed stays false until a human reviewer accepts the dispositions.

findings.disposition: The labels sit on one-pin stubs generated for the schematic; the PCB netlist still joins the source's nets. Not a design change.
A pin marked no-connect is touched by a wire in the generated drawing. The source netlist is the authority; a reviewer should confirm the two pins.

The embedded MCP6022, BSC030N08NS5 and 2N3904 symbols are flattened copies of library symbols that use `extends`; KiCad reports the copy differs from the library. The embedded copy is the one the project uses.
The GATE_REV label touches more than one wire segment of the same net.

part_review.evidence: Every authored part has reviewed_by = "" by design, so W-SYNTH-PART-UNVERIFIED fires and `synth registry qualify` blocks on E-SYNTH-QUAL-008. No reviewer has checked the ten authored parts against their datasheets.

thermal_and_power.evidence: The AMS1117-3.3 estimate is 0.73 W in a 60 C/W package, about 107 C junction at 25 C ambient (W-SYNTH-THERMAL-001). No thermal measurement, no junction-temperature calculation for the MOSFETs, and no current-loop or EMI analysis.

connector_review.evidence: The 2.5 A/contact rating is from the LCSC product pages; the Phoenix terminal-block datasheets were read with Firecrawl on 2026-11-03 (17.5 A, 400 V III/2, 5.08 mm, LCSC C480516/C480520). The 50% derating and the current table are hand calculations; no stack-height, keying or creepage check was done.

fabrication_review.evidence: No Gerbers or drill files were generated because routing failed. No fab accepted the board, and 2 oz outer copper, via-in-pad and the 10 A terminals were not quoted.

hardware_test.evidence: not powered, not programmed, not measured

reproducible_hashes.evidence: SHA256SUMS was generated locally on 2026-11-03. No CI run has produced a golden set for this board, and the routed artifact does not exist.
